name: pallets
about: A town's pallets as its host shows them (pallet_host.rs). Pallets made with two dials raised so one holds three crates. A player has Far's Merchant pack paper for Mid (a pallet of three crates) and for Hub (one crate): pallets in Far's warehouse (PalletPacked), a bill each. Asked what to put in Far's desk's chests with two slots free, the core offers only Hub's pallet: a chest takes a pallet whole or not at all; with four, both, and the host says it put them there (Stowed). A player carries Mid's pallet to Hub, a town on the way that isn't its consignee: it waits there, packed (PalletMoved), shown nowhere until Hub's chests take it. Two of its three crates reach Mid: at Mid's next look the pallet is received short, its seal broken, Mid taking what came and the third crate a loss in the books (PalletOpened; the registry's lost goods). Hub's wagon to Far fetches the crate packed for Hub, sealed as it leaves (on the manifest, one line, no superbill), and Hub receives it home.
